recipes.name: Almond Flax Granola
recipes.notes: Bake at home; the batch makes about 5 cups, so bag roughly 2/3 cup per serve with 2 tablespoons of milk powder. Add cold water at camp.

recipes.name: Apple Cinnamon Quinoa Porridge
recipes.notes: At home cook the quinoa with the apple, cinnamon, maple and vanilla, then dehydrate it and bag with coconut milk powder and pecans. At camp cover with boiling water, simmer a minute and rest 10 minutes in a cosy.

recipes.name: Apple Cinnamon Trail Pancakes
recipes.notes: One serve in one zip bag: flour, oats, milk powder, baking powder, sugar, chopped dried apple and cinnamon. At camp add about 120 ml water to the bag, squish to mix, snip a corner and pipe into a buttered pan.

recipes.name: Apple Pie Overnight Oats
recipes.notes: Adapted with milk powder and dried apple instead of almond milk, yoghurt and applesauce. Bag it all at home; add about 200 ml water in a jar at night and it is ready in the morning.

recipes.name: Apricot Ginger Oats
recipes.notes: Chop the apricots and crystallised ginger at home and bag with the oats, almonds, coconut milk powder, salt and sugar. At camp stir in boiling water, cover for 3-4 minutes and add a little coconut oil if you like.

recipes.name: Backpacker Bircher Muesli
recipes.notes: Pack oats and dried fruit in one bag, toppings and milk powder in another. Soak oats and fruit in 355 ml cold water in a sealed jar overnight (or 1-2 hours), then stir in the milk powder and add the toppings.

recipes.name: Backpacker Breakfast Burrito
recipes.notes: At home: bag the dry filling; pack tortillas separately. At camp: add about 300 ml boiling water to the bag (for 2), seal 10 min, then spoon into tortillas.

recipes.name: Backpacker's Chia Pudding
recipes.notes: Assumes the full mix is one hungry serve. Shake chia seeds with about 240 ml water (or rehydrated milk) and honey in a jar, wait 15-20 minutes for it to gel, then add freeze-dried fruit and nuts.

recipes.name: Banana Egg Pancake
recipes.notes: A first-morning treat while eggs are fresh. Mash a banana with a fork, beat in two eggs and cook small rounds in a little coconut oil over low heat, flipping gently.

recipes.name: Banana Peanut Burghul Porridge
recipes.notes: Adapted with milk powder and dried mango instead of fresh soy milk and mango. Simmer fine burghul and flaxseed in the milk and water for about 10 minutes, then top with sliced banana, peanuts and mango.

recipes.name: Banana Walnut Camp Pancakes
recipes.notes: Adapted for camp: egg powder and milk powder replace the fresh egg and milk, so the whole dry mix travels in one bag. At camp mash the bananas, add water to the dry mix to make a batter and cook small pancakes in a lightly greased pan.

recipes.name: Berry Breakfast Crumble
recipes.notes: One bag of freeze-dried berries, granola, pecans, chia and sugar, with the coconut oil in a small leak-proof tub. Add about 60 ml of hot or cold water and the oil, stir, and give the berries a minute or two to soften.

recipes.name: Berry Nut Instant Oatmeal
recipes.notes: At home: mix all dry ingredients in a bag. At camp: add about 240 ml boiling water, stir and stand 3-5 min.

recipes.name: Berry Polenta Porridge
recipes.notes: Adapted with milk powder and freeze-dried berries. Whisk the polenta into hot milk, stirring to stop lumps, add sugar, vanilla and spices, cook until thick and top with berries, flax and pepitas.

recipes.name: Biscuits & Sausage Gravy
recipes.notes: At home: bake buttermilk biscuits, cube and dry them (listed as breadcrumbs); dry sausage-seasoned beef mince. At camp: whisk the gravy mix into 300 ml water with the beef and veg, boil, then add the biscuit cubes and cozy 10-15 min.

recipes.name: Blueberry Banana Camp Pancakes
recipes.notes: Adapted with dried blueberries and powdered egg and milk so the batter mix keeps for days. At camp add about 250 ml water, slice a banana into the batter and cook small pancakes over medium-low heat.

recipes.name: Blueberry Coconut Oats
recipes.notes: Everything goes into one bag at home. At camp pour about 250 ml of boiling water per serve over the mix, stir and leave it covered for a few minutes.

recipes.name: Blueberry Polenta Pancakes
recipes.notes: Everything dry goes in one bag at home: polenta, wholemeal flour, wheat germ, milk powder, baking powder, salt and dried blueberries. At camp add the oil and about 360 ml water, shake or stir, and cook small pancakes.

recipes.name: Bushwalker Flapjacks
recipes.notes: At home: sift flour, salt and milk powder into a bag. At camp: gradually whisk in water to a thick lump-free batter, rest 30 min, fry both sides in butter and spread with jam.

recipes.name: Bushwalker Pancakes
recipes.notes: Assumes 1 serving. At home: bag the dry mix. At camp: add water to make about 375 ml batter, rest 30 min, then fry in a lightly buttered pan. Serve with honey.

recipes.name: Camp Stove Chilaquiles
recipes.notes: A first-morning breakfast while eggs and onion are still fresh. Fry tortilla wedges in oil until crisp, soften the onion and garlic, pour in the tomato sauce, then crack the eggs on top and cover until set.

recipes.name: Caramelised Banana Porridge
recipes.notes: Adapted with milk powder in the oats and orange juice from a popper. Cook the oats in one pot while the banana chunks fry in butter and brown sugar in a pan, splash in the juice to make a sauce and spoon it over the porridge with pecans.

recipes.name: Cheesy Cream Potatoes & Beef Chili
recipes.notes: At home: cook a beef and bean chili, dehydrate and portion about 45 g per person; bag potato flakes and cheese powder separately. At camp: soak chili in 475 ml water 5 min, boil, stir in potato and cheese, cozy 10 min.

recipes.name: Cheesy Shrimp & Grits
recipes.notes: At home: bag grits, dried shrimp and dried peppers/onions; pack the cheese and milk powders separately. At camp: soak in 355 ml water 5 min, bring to the boil, take off the heat, stir in the powders and cozy 10 min.

recipes.name: Chickpea Flour Breakfast Scramble
recipes.notes: Adapted for the trail with dried onion, capsicum and tomato instead of fresh. Bag the chickpea flour, nutritional yeast, spices and dried veg; at camp whisk with about 250 ml water per serve and cook like scrambled eggs in an oiled pan.

source.title: Vegan Breakfast Scramble with Chickpea Flour

recipes.name: Choc Banana Overnight Oats
recipes.notes: Adapted with milk powder. Mix oats, cocoa, chia and milk powder in a jar, add water and a squeeze of peanut butter at night, and mash or slice in the banana in the morning.

recipes.name: Choc Chip Camp Pancakes
recipes.notes: Adapted for camp with egg and milk powders in the dry mix. At home bag the flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and powders; at camp add about 250 ml water, stir in the chocolate chips and cook in a greased pan.

recipes.name: Choc Coconut Granola with Milk
recipes.notes: Bake the oat, nut, cacao and coconut granola at home, cool it and bag each serve with a spoon of milk powder and some freeze-dried raspberries. At camp just add cold water and eat.

recipes.name: Cinnamon Apple Camp Pancakes
recipes.notes: Adapted with powdered egg and milk, plus apple juice made from water. Carry the dry mix and two apples; grate one into the batter and fry the other in butter, cinnamon and sugar as the topping.

recipes.name: Cinnamon Breakfast Bannock
recipes.notes: At home: mix all dry ingredients in a zip bag (raising agent shown as baking powder). At camp: stir in 160 ml water and the oil, spoon into a greased warm pan and cook gently about 10 min a side. Serve with honey or jam.

recipes.name: Cinnamon Walnut Granola
recipes.notes: Bake the granola at home and bag about 3/4 cup per person with 2 tablespoons of milk powder (or coconut milk powder to keep it vegan). At camp just add cold water.

recipes.name: Coconut Chia Porridge
recipes.notes: Mix oats, chia and salt in a bag at home and carry a small tin of coconut milk. At camp warm the coconut milk with a splash of water, stir in the dry mix and maple syrup and simmer gently until thick.

recipes.name: Coconut Chia Pudding
recipes.notes: At home: bag chia, coconut milk powder, fruit and granola. At camp: add 240 ml cold water, shake or stir well and leave at least 15 min (or overnight).

recipes.name: Date and Nut Breakfast Loaf
recipes.notes: At home: soften dates in maple syrup, fold into a seeded flour, oat and walnut batter with sour cream (or yoghurt), coconut cream and oil, and bake 60-80 min. Cool before slicing; about 12 slices.

recipes.name: Diamonds Overnight Oats Jar
recipes.notes: The night before: combine oats, chia, yoghurt, milk and honey in a 500 ml jar and refrigerate (or keep in the esky). Eat cold in the morning; add dried fruit, nuts or protein powder to taste.

recipes.name: Egg Scramble with Spinach and Capsicum
recipes.notes: Bag the egg powder, dried capsicum, dried spinach and seasoning together. At camp whisk the mix with 300 ml water for two, let the veg soak a few minutes, then scramble in an oiled pan.

source.title: Backpacking Breakfast Scramble with Spinach and Sun Dried Peppers

recipes.name: Egg-Powder French Toast
recipes.notes: Mix the egg powder with water in a zip bag to make a batter. Dip each slice of bread, fry in oil until golden on both sides and finish with butter and maple syrup. Sturdy bread holds up best in a pack.

recipes.name: Folded Breakfast Quesadilla
recipes.notes: Cook the beaten eggs like an omelette without stirring, lay a tortilla on top before they fully set, flip, add cheese and a second tortilla and toast both sides. Serve with salsa.

recipes.name: Ginger Pumpkin Seed Granola
recipes.notes: Bake at home and bag one-sixth of the batch per breakfast with 2 tablespoons of milk powder. At camp add cold water.

recipes.name: Granola with Milk and Berries
recipes.notes: The simplest hot-weather breakfast: one bag of granola, milk powder and freeze-dried blueberries and strawberries. Add about 120 ml cold water, stir, and wait a minute for the berries to soften.

recipes.name: Ironman Fruit and Nut Oats
recipes.notes: Adapted with coconut milk powder instead of almond milk. Bag the oats with apricots, coconut, sunflower seeds, almonds, cinnamon and milk powder, add about 250 ml boiling water and leave covered for a few minutes; sweeten with maple.

recipes.name: Lemon Blueberry Oats
recipes.notes: Bag quick oats, milk powder, freeze-dried blueberries, almonds, brown sugar and lemon powder together. At camp add hot (or cold) water bit by bit until it is the thickness you like, then stir in the coconut oil.

recipes.name: Maple Pecan Granola with Milk
recipes.notes: At home: bake the oat, seed and nut mix with oil and maple syrup until golden, cool and crumble. Bag 1 cup per person with dried fruit, nuts, coconut and milk powder. At camp: add about 240 ml cold water and stir.

source.title: Chef Glenn's Best Granola Recipe / Granola & Milk for Breakfast

recipes.name: Mocha Banana Oats
recipes.notes: Adapted with milk powder. Bag the oats, instant coffee, cocoa, milk powder and walnuts; at camp cook in about 250 ml water with half a mashed banana, then slice the rest on top with a drizzle of honey.

recipes.name: Nut Butter Cold-Soak Oats
recipes.notes: Bag the rolled oats with milk powder, chia, vanilla powder, brown sugar and cinnamon, and carry a squeeze pack of honey almond butter. Add about 150 ml cold water, stir in the nut butter and let it stand at least 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Oat Drop Bannocks
recipes.notes: Assumes 1 serving. At home: mix the dry ingredients. At camp: stir in 1 cup water, stand 5-10 min, drop spoonfuls on an oiled hot pan and flip when bubbles form. Serve with maple syrup.

recipes.name: Oat Pancakes with Dried Fruit Compote
recipes.notes: Uses a just-add-water pancake mix, so there is almost no prep. Simmer chopped dried fruit with brown sugar and water to a syrupy compote while you mix oats, pancake mix, cinnamon and pecans with water and fry the pancakes.

source.title: Oatmeal Pancakes with Dried Fruit Compote

recipes.name: Oatmeal with Apples, Raisins & Cinnamon
recipes.notes: At camp: soak the oats, dried apple, raisins, sugar, cinnamon and salt in 300 ml water 5 min, boil 1 min stirring, then top with the granola or nuts.

recipes.name: Overnight-Soaked Steel-Cut Oats
recipes.notes: Steel-cut oats normally need a long simmer; soaking them overnight in the pot cuts that to about 5 minutes. Put the oats, salt and water in the pot at night, bring to the boil in the morning and top with raisins and walnuts.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Oat Protein Shake
recipes.notes: Grind the oats and chia fine at home so the shake is smooth, then bag them with milk powder, peanut butter powder, cocoa and brown sugar. Shake with about 240 ml cold water and let it thicken for 5-10 minutes.

recipes.name: Pistachio Raisin Breakfast Couscous
recipes.notes: A warm change from porridge. Bag couscous, milk powder, raisins, chopped pistachios, sugar and a pinch of cardamom; at camp stir into about 320 ml boiling water, take off the heat and leave covered for 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Pizza Grits Supreme
recipes.notes: At camp: soak grits, dried veg, ham and pineapple in 300 ml water 5 min, boil 1 min, cozy 10 min, then stir the cheese through before eating.

recipes.name: Poha Hiking Breakfast
recipes.notes: At home: pack flattened rice and a separate mix of peas, peanuts, currants, roasted edamame, seeds, spices and fried shallots. At camp: pour boiling water through the rice in a cloth to soften (no soaking), rehydrate the peas in a cup, mix together.

recipes.name: Protein Brekky Muffins
recipes.notes: At home: beat eggs, cream cheese, almond meal and baking powder, stir in cheddar, ham and squeezed spinach, bake 15 min in a 12-hole tray. Keep chilled; eat on day 1. One serve = 2 muffins.

recipes.name: Ramen Noodle Omelette
recipes.notes: Uses fresh eggs, so plan it for the first morning (or use 4 tablespoons of egg powder plus water). Soften the noodles in boiling water and drain, pour the beaten eggs over them in an oiled pan and cook until set; season with soy and vinegar.

recipes.name: Raspberry Almond Cacao Oats
recipes.notes: Bag the oats with flaxseed, cacao nibs, freeze-dried raspberries, brown sugar and salt. At camp add boiling water, stir in a squeeze pack of almond butter and wait a couple of minutes.

recipes.name: Salmon Scramble
recipes.notes: At camp: whisk the egg powder with 120 ml water, scramble in the coconut oil, then fold through the flaked salmon and dill. Season to taste.

recipes.name: Savoury Polenta with Kale Chips and Seeds
recipes.notes: Adapted with instant polenta in place of quick grits. Whisk the polenta into boiling stock, keep stirring until thick and creamy, then stir in cashew butter and top with crumbled kale chips and sunflower seeds.

source.title: Creamy Grits with Kale and Sunflower Seeds

recipes.name: Sierra's Porridge
recipes.notes: At home: bag oats, milk powder, sugar, salt and fruit/nuts. At camp: pour on about twice the volume of boiling water, stir, cover and stand 10 min.

recipes.name: Skillet-Toasted Camp Granola
recipes.notes: Bag the oats, pecans, coconut, cranberries and salt, and carry the maple syrup and oil in a small bottle. At camp toast everything in a pan, stirring, until golden and sticky, cool a few minutes, then add milk powder and cold water.

source.title: Pecan and Maple Granola in a Bag

recipes.name: Spiced Apple Porridge
recipes.notes: Pre-mix the oats, warm spices and seeds at home; carry one fresh apple. At camp dice the apple into the pot with the water, bring to the boil, add the oat mix and stir until creamy, then sweeten with maple syrup.

recipes.name: Spiced Quinoa Porridge with Blueberries
recipes.notes: Adapted with milk powder and dried blueberries. Simmer the quinoa with the water, milk powder and whole spices for about 15 minutes, then stir in sugar, almonds, apricots and blueberries.

source.title: Quinoa Breakfast Porridge with Hot Blueberry Drizzle

recipes.name: Strawberries and Cream Quinoa Porridge
recipes.notes: Cook the quinoa with maple, cinnamon and vanilla at home, dry it with sliced strawberries, and pack it with coconut milk powder and coconut. At camp add hot water, simmer briefly and let it sit covered until soft.

recipes.name: Superfood Blueberry Overnight Oats
recipes.notes: Combine everything except the water in a bag or jar at home. Cover with water the night before (or at least two hours ahead), give it a shake and eat cold.

recipes.name: Thin Camp Crepes
recipes.notes: Adapted with powdered egg and milk. Make a thin batter with the dry mix and water, rest it a few minutes, and swirl small ladlefuls around a buttered pan. Fill with jam, Nutella, or lemon and sugar.

recipes.name: Tip and Mix Pecan Porridge
recipes.notes: Shake the oats, cinnamon, vanilla powder, pecans, chia and coconut sugar together in a jar before leaving. At camp split between two bowls, pour boiling water over, stir, and finish with nut butter, maple syrup, more pecans and fruit if you have it.

source.title: The Three Bears Tip n Mix Porridge

recipes.name: Tropical Coconut Quinoa Porridge
recipes.notes: Adapted with coconut milk powder and dried figs. Boil the quinoa for about 15 minutes, stir in the coconut milk powder, then top with sliced banana, chopped figs and coconut.

recipes.name: Tropical Pineapple Overnight Oats
recipes.notes: Adapted with dried pineapple and milk powder so nothing needs chilling. Bag it all, add about 220 ml water in a jar at night and eat it cold for breakfast.

recipes.name: Vegan Chia Trail Pancakes
recipes.notes: No eggs or milk needed: flour, oats, chia, cornflour, sugar, cinnamon, salt and baking powder go in a freezer bag. At camp add the water and oil, knead the bag to mix and cook pancakes in a non-stick pan; top with honey or lemon and sugar.

recipes.name: Watagans Zucchini Breakfast Muffins
recipes.notes: At home: mix squeezed grated zucchini and carrot with corn, cheese, milk, yoghurt, oil and eggs, fold in flour and baking powder, bake 20-25 min. Makes 12; one serve = 2 muffins. Freeze ahead if needed.

recipes.name: Avocado Tuna Smash
recipes.notes: Adapted without the celery. Halve a ripe avocado, mash in a tin of oil-packed tuna with capers, lemon and pepper, and eat it straight from the skin or on crackers. Avocados travel well for the first couple of days.

recipes.name: Baked Bean and Cheese Toasties
recipes.notes: A good car-camp or first-day lunch. Butter the outside of the bread, fill with cheese and a spoon of baked beans, and toast in a pan or jaffle iron over the stove or coals until golden on both sides.

recipes.name: Billy Damper with Sultanas
recipes.notes: At camp: mix flour, salt and sultanas, rub in butter and add milk (from powder) to a firm dough. Cook on baking paper in a lidded billy on a very low flame until crusty underneath, flip and cook about 5 min more.

recipes.name: Black Bean Tortilla Soup
recipes.notes: Simmer black beans, fire-roasted tomatoes, corn, onion, jalapeno and spices at home, then dry. At camp add boiling water and stock cubes, simmer a few minutes, and crush corn chips over the top with a little oil and lime powder.

recipes.name: Blueberry and Corn Salad
recipes.notes: At home: cut kernels from blanched or charred corn, toss with blueberries, cucumber, red onion and coriander in a lime, oil, honey and cumin dressing. Pack in a sealed container and keep cool.

recipes.name: Bouddi Coconut Rice Salad
recipes.notes: At home: cook jasmine rice in coconut milk, cool, fold through diced capsicum, cabbage, carrot and onions; warm peanut butter, honey, ginger, vinegar and sesame oil into a sauce. Pack separately and keep cool. Serves assumed 4.

source.title: Bouddi Rice Salad with Ginger Peanut Sauce

recipes.name: Buffalo Pasta Salad
recipes.notes: Precook and dehydrate the macaroni at home and bag it with dried capsicum, jalapeno and onion; keep the buffalo seasoning in a separate small bag. Soak in cold water, drain well, then stir in the seasoning and mayo sachets.

recipes.name: Carrot and Red Lentil Soup
recipes.notes: Adapted with dried carrot and onion, stock powder and milk powder in place of yoghurt. Simmer the lentils and veg in the stock for about 20 minutes, mash a bit with the spoon, then stir in the milk powder and lemon.

source.title: Spiced Carrot and Red Lentil Soup

recipes.name: Carrot, Corn and Zucchini Slice
recipes.notes: At home: combine squeezed grated carrot and zucchini with corn, cheese, flour, parsley and seasonings, stir in egg, milk and oil, bake 30 min. Cut into squares and carry chilled. Serves assumed 6.

recipes.name: Cheese & Herb Bannock
recipes.notes: Assumes 3 serves. At home: mix the dry ingredients. At camp: rub in butter, add cheese and about 1 cup water to a soft dough, shape an 18 cm round and cook in an oiled pan on low, turning once (about 8 min a side).

recipes.name: Cheesy Bean and Corn Quesadillas
recipes.notes: Adapted with tinned beans and corn and dried capsicum so only the cheese needs keeping cool. Fill two tortillas per person with grated cheese, beans, corn and capsicum and toast in a dry pan until melted; serve with salsa.

recipes.name: Chilli Lime Peanut Noodles
recipes.notes: Throw away the noodle flavour sachet and bag the sugar, ginger, chilli and peanuts instead; carry a peanut butter squeeze pack and a lime powder sachet. Cook the noodles, drain most of the water and stir everything through.

recipes.name: Coal-Baked Damper
recipes.notes: Campfire only (check fire bans). Mix the dry ingredients with just enough water for a dryish dough, flatten to about 3 cm, wrap loosely in foil and bury in hot coals about 25 min.

recipes.name: Coconut Curry Noodle Soup
recipes.notes: One small bag: coconut milk powder, a stock cube, curry powder, cayenne, rice noodles and dried veg. Drop it all into about 480 ml boiling water and simmer 2-3 minutes.

recipes.name: Coconut Laksa-Style Cup Noodles
recipes.notes: At home: bag broken rice noodles with coconut milk powder, a little laksa paste, stock powder and dried veg and shallots. At camp: pour just-boiled water over in a mug, cover 5-7 min. Noodle and veg amounts estimated.

source.title: Easy No-Simmer Camp Soups: Coconut Laksa-Style Noodle Soup

recipes.name: Cold-Soak Bean Salad
recipes.notes: At home: marinate diced veg, beans, corn and herbs in the dressing overnight, then dehydrate. On the track: cover with cold water at least 2 hours before lunch, then add a splash of olive oil. Serves estimated from ~75 g dry portions.

recipes.name: Cold-Soak Chicken Salad Wraps
recipes.notes: At home: bag the chicken and chives. At camp: add about 180 ml cold water (for 2), soak 15-20 min, drain any excess, stir through mayo and season. Spread on wraps or crackers.

recipes.name: Cold-Soak Chickpea Pasta Salad
recipes.notes: Adapted with dried capsicum, onion and tomato instead of fresh salad veg; the chickpeas are dehydrated at home. Soak the pasta, chickpeas and veg in cold water for an hour or two, drain, then toss with oil, herbs and lemon powder.

recipes.name: Cold-Soak Sushi Rice Bowl
recipes.notes: At home: cook short-grain rice, season with rice vinegar, sugar and salt, then dehydrate with sliced cucumber and surimi. On trail: combine with about 255 ml cold water in a leak-proof jar and wait 1-1.5 h.

recipes.name: Cold-Soak Tuna Orzo Salad
recipes.notes: At home: cook orzo, dehydrate, and bag with dried mixed vegetables. On the trail: add 240 ml cold water in a leak-proof jar and soak about an hour, then stir in the tuna and mayonnaise; season to taste.

recipes.name: Cream of Chicken and Corn Cup-a-Soup
recipes.notes: At home: make a rich chicken stock, cook corn, leek, carrot, celery and beans in it, puree, dry into bark and powder; mix with milk powder and dried herbs. At camp: stir about 25 g powder into a cup of boiling water. Serves estimated.

source.title: Homemade Instant Cup-a-Soup 1: Dehydrated Cream of Chicken and Corn

recipes.name: Creamy Chicken & Potato Soup
recipes.notes: At home: cook the vegetables in stages with broth, add chicken and potatoes, blend part of it for creaminess, then dehydrate and crumble (about ¾ cup per serving). At camp: soak in 355 ml water 5 min, boil, cozy 15 min.

recipes.name: Curried Mi Goreng Hiking Noodles
recipes.notes: Boil the noodles and freeze-dried veg for two minutes and drain off the water. Stir in the packet sauces with curry powder, soy and a drizzle of sesame oil, and sprinkle the fried onions over the top.

source.title: How to Make Mi Goreng Packet Hiking Noodles

recipes.name: Curried Salmon Salad Sandwich
recipes.notes: Pre-cut the apple and celery at home and bag them. On the trail: stir the mayo sachets and curry powder into the salmon pouch, spread on the buns and top with the apple, celery and dried cherries (cranberries used here).

recipes.name: Diamonds Burrito Bowls
recipes.notes: At home: saute spiced black beans and corn, make coriander-lime rice, tomato salsa, charred capsicum and guacamole; pack in containers and keep cool. On the trail assemble with lettuce and corn chips. Serves assumed 4.

recipes.name: Diamonds Corn and Zucchini Fritters
recipes.notes: At home: squeeze grated zucchini, mix with corn, spring onion, herbs, egg, flour, baking powder and cumin, and pan-fry 1/4-cup dollops. Eat cold on the track. Makes about 10; one serve = about 3.

recipes.name: Diamonds Miso Noodle Cup Soup
recipes.notes: At home: pack a miso sachet with broken vermicelli, dried seaweed, snapped shiitake and sesame seeds. At camp: pour near-boiling water over noodles and add-ins, cover 3-5 min, stir in miso once slightly cooled. Amounts estimated.

source.title: Easy No-Simmer Camp Soups: Miso Noodle Soup

recipes.name: Diamonds Spinach and Feta Pie
recipes.notes: At home: mix sauteed onion, garlic and toasted pine nuts with three cheeses, eggs, herbs and squeezed spinach, bake in puff pastry about 30 min. Cool, slice and carry chilled for lunch. About 8 slices (assumed).

recipes.name: Edamame Hummus & Veggie Tortillas
recipes.notes: At home: blend cooked edamame, chickpeas, lemon, basil and garlic, dehydrate and grind to powder. On trail: cold-soak the dried veg for ~2 h; mix 4 tbsp powder with 6 tbsp water and 2 tbsp olive oil, spread on 2 tortillas.

recipes.name: Garlic Parmesan Ramen
recipes.notes: Ditch the flavour sachet and pack the noodles with parsley, garlic powder, pepper and salt, plus parmesan and olive oil. Soak or simmer the noodles until soft, drain off the extra water, and toss with the rest.

recipes.name: Ham Stock and Bean Soup
recipes.notes: At home: make a ham hock stock, cook diced vegetables and beans in it, dehydrate; powder some for instant cup-a-soup. At camp: pour boiling water over the powder for a cup, or rehydrate the chunky mix in a cosy 20-25 min. Serves estimated.

source.title: Homemade Instant Cup-a-Soup 2: Ham Stock and Bean Soup

recipes.name: Herby Red Lentil and Burghul Spread
recipes.notes: Make at home (adapted with dried parsley so it keeps a little longer): cook lentils and burghul, fry onion, garlic, tomato paste and spices in oil, and mash it all together. Carry in a sealed tub for the first two days and eat with crackers or wraps.

recipes.name: Hiker's Fresh Pasta Salad
recipes.notes: At home: shake an oil-free vinaigrette (aquafaba, lemon, vinegar, soy, maple, garlic, nutritional yeast, herbs); toss cooled spiral pasta with chopped veg, olives and chickpeas in it. Chill and pack in containers.

recipes.name: Hummus Lentil Wraps
recipes.notes: Adapted with tinned lentils and tortillas, with rocket as an optional first-day extra. Spread each wrap with hummus, add drained lentils and chopped olives and roll tightly in foil.

recipes.name: Instant Hummus
recipes.notes: At home: toast the chickpea flour and sesame seeds in a dry pan, cool, mix with seasonings. At camp: stir in about 60 ml water per serve and the olive oil to a smooth paste.

recipes.name: Janet's Mini Vegetable Frittatas
recipes.notes: At home: mix sauteed onion with grated carrot and zucchini, corn, cheese, wholemeal SR flour, eggs and oil, spoon into a greased muffin tray, top with sunflower kernels and bake 30 min. Makes 12; one serve = 2.

recipes.name: Lemon Chickpea and Quinoa Salad
recipes.notes: At home: cook and fully cool quinoa (~45 g dry gives 3/4 cup cooked), combine with well-dried chickpeas, cucumber, tomato, onion and olives, dress with oil and lemon, add feta last. Pack in a sealed container.

recipes.name: Lentil & Noodle Soup
recipes.notes: At camp (or from breakfast): soak lentils and onion in water for about an hour. Bring to the boil with more water, add noodles, stock cube, bacon chips and basil and cook until soft.

recipes.name: Mi Goreng Jaffle
recipes.notes: Cook and drain a packet of mi goreng with its seasonings, mix in a beaten egg and some cheese, and pack it between buttered bread in the jaffle iron. Toast over the coals until crisp; a squirt of mayo is optional.

source.title: 3 Jaffle Recipes to Try at Your Next Campout

recipes.name: Mortadella Provolone Campfire Toastie
recipes.notes: A first-day car-camp lunch while the deli meat and cheese are cold. Butter the outside of thick sourdough, fill with mustard, mortadella, provolone, pickles and a few radicchio leaves, and toast in a skillet over the fire until the cheese oozes.

recipes.name: Mushroom and Pea Couscous
recipes.notes: Bag the couscous with finely chopped dried mushrooms, dried peas, salt, herbs and plenty of pepper. Simmer the mushrooms and peas in the water for a few minutes first, then add the couscous, cover off the heat and finish with parmesan.

source.title: Backpacking Recipe Formula (Couscous with Mushrooms and Peas)

recipes.name: Nori and Corn Ramen
recipes.notes: Swap the noodle flavour sachet for a stock cube and add crumbled toasted nori and dried corn. Simmer everything a few minutes, then finish with soy, a knob of butter and chilli flakes.

recipes.name: Pan Chapattis
recipes.notes: Makes 10 (about 3 each). At camp: mix flour and salt, work in about 3/4 cup water to a soft dough, rest 15 min, divide and flatten, and dry-cook both sides in a moderate pan. Good with curries.

recipes.name: Pasta e Ceci Soup
recipes.notes: Adapted for camp: dried onion and carrot replace fresh, and stock powder replaces boxed broth. Soften the veg and tomato paste in oil, add the chickpeas, stock and pasta and simmer until tender, then stir in parmesan.

recipes.name: Peach Salsa Rice Salad
recipes.notes: At home: make a fresh tomato-peach salsa and dehydrate it; cook and dry short-grain rice. Pack about 80 g rice and 40 g salsa each. On trail: add 240 ml cold water and wait 1.5-2 h.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Banana Wrap
recipes.notes: Spread a tortilla with peanut butter and honey, scatter sunflower seeds and roll it around a whole banana. Squeeze-pack peanut butter makes this easy on the trail.

recipes.name: Peanut Dressing Pasta Salad
recipes.notes: Adapted with dried vegetables and ground ginger. Mix the dressing at home in a small leak-proof jar. Cook the pasta with the dried veg, drain, cool a little and toss with the dressing and peanuts.

source.title: Pasta Salad With Peanut Butter Dressing

recipes.name: Red Curry Noodle Jar
recipes.notes: Adapted for the pack: dried edamame-style veg replace fresh, and a shelf-stable tofu pouch or a boiled egg from home adds protein. Mix the paste, oil, soy, sugar and lemon in a small jar; at camp simmer the rice noodles in the stock, then stir in the paste.

source.title: Easy Homemade Ramen in a Jar

recipes.name: Roasted Capsicum Hummus (Dehydrated)
recipes.notes: Blend the chickpeas, roasted capsicum, sesame seeds, garlic, lemon and salt at home and dry the paste into a crumbly powder. On the trail rehydrate with cold water, stir in a tablespoon of olive oil and scoop with crackers.

recipes.name: Savoury Chickpea Flour Pancake
recipes.notes: Adapted with dried capsicum, peas and spring onion. Whisk the chickpea flour, spices and dried veg with about 120 ml water, rest 5 minutes so the veg soften, then cook one big pancake in oil and top with hummus.

recipes.name: Smoky Chickpea Wraps
recipes.notes: A first-day lunch while the tomatoes and avocado are fresh. Pan-fry the chickpeas with paprika and vinegar until crisp, then fill the wraps with chickpeas, tomato, onion, avocado, yoghurt and sriracha.

recipes.name: Soba Ramen with Jerky and Shiitake
recipes.notes: Snap the soba noodles and bag them with freeze-dried veg, jerky and dried shiitake. At camp boil everything in about 500 ml water until the noodles are soft, then season with soy, sesame oil and sriracha sachets.

recipes.name: Speedy Chickpea and Tomato Stew
recipes.notes: Adapted with dried capsicum and parsley. Simmer a tin each of chickpeas and tomatoes with the capsicum, coriander, cumin and a little sugar for 10 minutes and serve with bread to mop it up.

recipes.name: Spiced Fig and Raisin Couscous Salad
recipes.notes: Adapted with dried fruit and dried capsicum instead of fresh salad items. Bag the couscous with the spices, raisins, figs, sunflower seeds and capsicum; add boiling water, cover 5 minutes, fluff with oil and season.

recipes.name: Spicy Salmon Ramen
recipes.notes: At camp: boil about 250 ml water, cook the noodles with the flavour sachet, add chilli flakes and tip into the opened salmon pouch. Stir and eat from the pouch.

recipes.name: Sun-Dried Tomato Herb Couscous
recipes.notes: Supermarket-only ingredients: couscous, diced sun-dried tomato, pine nuts, dried herbs, turmeric, garlic, pepper and salt in one bag. Add about 180 ml boiling (or cold) water, cover for 5 minutes, fluff and drizzle with olive oil.

recipes.name: Sun-Dried Tomato Hummus Bowl
recipes.notes: Bag the hummus powder with chopped sun-dried tomatoes and pine nuts, and pack crackers or pretzels for dipping. At lunch stir in cold water a little at a time until smooth and finish with a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.name: Suz's Lentil Tabbouleh Protein Bowl
recipes.notes: At home: boil the egg 7 min, pan-fry haloumi and falafel, toss lentils with chopped tomato, cucumber, spring onion and herbs in lemon and oil. Pack over salad leaves with hummus; keep cool overnight.

recipes.name: Sweet and Spicy Cashew Chicken Wrap
recipes.notes: Carry a pouch of cooked chicken, wraps, cashews and single-serve mayo, honey and sriracha sachets. At lunch mix the filling right in the pouch and spoon it into the wraps.

recipes.name: Tahini Soba Noodle Salad
recipes.notes: A crunchy first-day lunch. Cook and rinse the soba, slice the fresh veg, and toss with a dressing of tahini, water, lemon juice, honey, salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Thai Beetroot Slaw
recipes.notes: At home: cut beetroot and carrot into matchsticks, add shredded cabbage, red onion and herbs; pack the sweet chilli, lime, fish and soy dressing separately and toss with fried shallots when serving. Serves assumed 3.

recipes.name: Tuna & Pasta San Marzano Salad
recipes.notes: At home: bag precooked-and-dried macaroni with dried tomato, green beans and olives; carry a tuna pouch. On trail: cold-soak the dry mix in 180 ml water for 2-2.5 h, then stir in the tuna.

recipes.name: Tuna Parmesan Salad Pouch
recipes.notes: Adapted to use a ready-made tuna pouch instead of home-dried tuna, so no water is needed. Stir dried spring onion, onion flakes, pepper, parmesan and a mayo sachet into the pouch and eat with crackers or a wrap.

recipes.name: Unstuffed Peppers Thermos Lunch
recipes.notes: At home: dehydrate cooked rice, ground beef, capsicum and tomato sauce (as leather). In the morning: add 530 ml boiled water to the bag contents in a thermos food jar; ready by lunch. Or boil in a pot and cozy 15 min.

recipes.name: Vegemite and Cheese Jaffle
recipes.notes: The Aussie classic. Butter the outsides of two slices, spread Vegemite inside, add grated cheese, clamp in a jaffle iron and toast over the coals for a few minutes each side.

source.title: 3 Jaffle Recipes to Try at Your Next Campout

recipes.name: Veggie Pho Noodle Soup
recipes.notes: Dehydrate the broccoli, cabbage, mushrooms, onion, carrot and spring onion at home and bag with thin rice noodles, stock powder and the pho spices. At camp simmer in about 480 ml water per person until the noodles are soft, then season with soy, hoisin and sriracha.

recipes.name: Vermicelli Noodle Salad
recipes.notes: Soak the rice vermicelli in boiled water, drain and cool. Toss with sliced carrot, celery, spring onion, cabbage and capsicum and a dressing of soy, rice vinegar, hoisin, sesame and olive oil, chilli and sugar.

recipes.name: Zesty Apple Bulgur Cold-Soak Salad
recipes.notes: At home: toss diced apple, carrot, capsicum, spring onion and parsley in a marmalade-lemon-spice dressing and dehydrate; cook and dry bulgur separately. On trail: cold-soak salad and bulgur in 240 ml water ~1 h, add cranberries, walnuts and oil.

recipes.name: Andrew's Chickpea Burritos
recipes.notes: Best late in a trip: soak chickpeas about 24 h as you walk. At camp: boil chickpeas and peas until tender, partly drain, stir in burrito mix, onion/garlic and cayenne to a sauce, and wrap in tortillas.

recipes.name: Andrew's Dahl & Burghul
recipes.notes: Assumes 2 serves. Soak lentils an hour if possible. At camp: pour boiling water over the burghul and cover; boil the lentils until soft, stir in coconut milk powder, spices and salt, and serve over the drained burghul.

recipes.name: Andrew's Harissa Couscous
recipes.notes: At home: premix couscous, TVP, harissa and currants. At camp: boil 670 ml water with stock and peas, take off the heat, stir in the couscous mix and let it swell; fork through oil and top with almonds and fried shallots.

recipes.name: Backcountry Bacon Carbonara
recipes.notes: Pack the thin pasta, a little egg powder and parmesan in separate bags with the bacon bits. Cook the pasta, drain nearly all the water, then stir in oil, egg powder, parmesan, pepper and bacon off the heat until it turns silky.

recipes.name: Backpacking Fried Rice with Egg
recipes.notes: At home: cook jasmine rice in stock, season with soy and oyster sauce, dehydrate; dry a mix of capsicum, carrot, peas and chickpeas. At camp: soak rice and veg in 315 ml water 5 min, boil, cozy 20 min; scramble the egg powder in a little oil and stir through.

recipes.name: Bacon & Nut Risotto
recipes.notes: Group recipe; assumes 4 serves. At camp: boil and drain rice with the dried veg; fry bacon and onion, then mix through with the nuts, soy sauce and herbs.

recipes.name: Bacon Potato Hash
recipes.notes: Group recipe; assumes 4 serves. At camp: fry the mettwurst, add water, dried veg and the soup mixes and simmer until soft, then stir in potato flakes to thicken.

recipes.name: Barbecue Beef Stew with Potato Bark
recipes.notes: At home: mash boiled potatoes with broth and barbecue sauce, spread thin and dry into bark; dry cooked beef mince and vegetables. At camp: soak about 32 g bark, 30 g beef and 20 g veg in 300 ml water 5 min, boil, cozy 10 min.

recipes.name: Barbeque Chicken Stew
recipes.notes: At home: mix cooked/canned chicken with BBQ sauce and dehydrate; dry grated potato, corn and butter beans. At camp: soak everything in 360 ml water 5 min, boil 1 min, cozy 10-15 min (or cold soak 45 min then heat).

recipes.name: Barley Risotto with Peas & Mushrooms
recipes.notes: At home: cook the barley risotto-style in stock with the peas, mushrooms, onion and garlic (extra stock can replace the wine), dehydrate and split into 2 bags. At camp: soak a portion in 300 ml water 5 min, boil 1 min, cozy 15 min.

recipes.name: Beef & Bean Chili with Rice
recipes.notes: At home: cook beef (mixed with breadcrumbs) with onion, garlic, chilli powder, beans and tomatoes, dehydrate and portion ~90 g with 50 g dried rice. At camp: soak in 355 ml water 5 min, boil 1 min, cozy 15 min.

recipes.name: Beef Chilli Mac (Dehydrated)
recipes.notes: Cook lean mince with breadcrumbs (they help it rehydrate), onion, garlic, spices, stock, macaroni and beans at home and dehydrate. Pack cheese powder and olive oil separately; at camp rehydrate in boiling water and stir them through.

recipes.name: Braised French Lentils
recipes.notes: At home: braise puy lentils with caramelised mushrooms, vegetables, stock and herbs, then dehydrate and powder the sauce. At camp: add boiling water to the bag, cosy 20-25 min, finish with olive oil. Serves estimated from ~150 g dry portions.

recipes.name: Bushwalker Cheese Fondue
recipes.notes: Assumes 1 serving; uses water rather than wine. At camp: melt butter, blend in flour and cayenne, gradually add milk made from the powder plus stock and onion, stir until thick, then melt in the cheeses. Dunk bread and kabana.

recipes.name: Bushwalker Spaghetti Bolognese
recipes.notes: At camp: soak the freeze-dried mince, onion and mushroom, simmer 5 min and stir in tomato paste. Cook and drain the spaghetti, toss with the sauce and top generously with parmesan. TVP + stock cube works for a vegetarian version.

recipes.name: Bushwalkers Tuna Mornay
recipes.notes: At camp: boil the rice (or pasta) with the dried veg and seasoning. Mix flour and milk powder with water to a paste and stir in to thicken, then add the tuna and cheese and heat through.

recipes.name: Cajun Red Beans and Instant Rice
recipes.notes: Adapted with dried onion instead of a fresh shallot. Bag the instant rice and dehydrated red beans with dried capsicum, cayenne, cumin, salt and tomato powder; simmer in the water until the beans soften and finish with olive oil.

recipes.name: Camp Pasta Puttanesca
recipes.notes: A pantry pasta built from tins and jars; adapted with dried onion and parsley instead of fresh. Cook the spaghetti, then in the same pot fry garlic, chilli and onion in olive oil, add the tomatoes, capers and olives and simmer before tossing the pasta back in.

recipes.name: Camp Yellow Chicken Curry
recipes.notes: A first-night group curry while the chicken is cold from the esky. Brown onion and chicken, add curry paste, cubed potato and carrot, coconut cream and a splash of water and simmer until tender; stir in peas and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Caramelised Pork Rice Bowl
recipes.notes: At home: cook pork mince with lemongrass, ginger and chilli in caramelised brown sugar and fish sauce, add roasted cauliflower and beans, dehydrate; par-cook and dry rice. At camp: bring meat mix to the boil in scant water, cosy 20 min; rehydrate rice in the pot.

recipes.name: Carrot, Coconut and Lentil Curry
recipes.notes: At home: simmer lentils, carrot and sweet potato with spices and passata, dehydrate the chunks and powder the puree; add coconut milk powder. At camp: add boiling water (more for soup), stir, cosy 20 min. Serves estimated.

source.title: Dehydrated Carrot, Coconut and Lentil Curry (or Instant Soup)

recipes.name: Cheese-O-Rama Ramen
recipes.notes: At home: bag half a block of ramen with dried ham and peas; pack cheese and milk powders separately. At camp: soak in 240 ml water 5 min, bring to the boil, stir in the powders off the heat and cozy 10 min.

recipes.name: Cheesy Broccoli Orzo
recipes.notes: Bag the orzo with a cheese-style soup mix and dried veg. Simmer in the water, stirring now and then, until the orzo is tender and saucy; add a chicken pouch for extra protein and parmesan or crushed chips on top.

recipes.name: Chef Glenn's Thai Green Curry
recipes.notes: At home: spread green curry paste thinly and dehydrate until crumbly; dry precooked jasmine rice, ground chicken and mixed veg. Pack coconut milk powder separately. At camp: combine all with 475 ml water, soak 5 min, boil, cozy 15 min.

recipes.name: Chef Glenn's Thai Red Curry with Tofu
recipes.notes: At home: dehydrate red curry paste until crumbly, and dry tofu, precooked rice and mixed veg. Pack coconut milk powder separately. At camp: combine all with 475 ml water, soak 5 min, boil, cozy 15 min.

recipes.name: Chicken Marbella Couscous
recipes.notes: Bag the couscous with chopped prunes, oregano, brown sugar, salt, garlic powder and stock powder; carry a chicken pouch and a sachet of green olives. Boil 300 ml water per person, pour over the couscous mix, cover 5 minutes, then fold in oil, chicken and olives.

recipes.name: Chicken with Creamy Spinach Sauce
recipes.notes: At home: dehydrate spinach cooked in broth and ground chicken; mix the sauce powders in a small bag. At camp: combine all with 355 ml water, soak 5 min, boil 1 min and cozy 15 min (or use boiled water in a thermos, 30 min). Stir before serving.

recipes.name: Chicken, Pumpkin and Coconut Curry
recipes.notes: At home: cook mince and onion without oil, add garlic, ginger, curry powder, pumpkin and coconut milk, simmer, add peas and mix with cooked rice; dehydrate thinly. At camp: about 150 g dry + 250-350 ml boiling water, stand 15-20 min.

recipes.name: Chilli Beans & Rice
recipes.notes: Group recipe; assumes 3 serves. Soak kidney beans from morning, drain, then boil hard until soft (at least 10 min fast boil). Fry onion with the spices, add beans and tomato powder; serve over boiled rice.

recipes.name: Chilli Beans with Corn Chips
recipes.notes: At home: slow-cook TVP, kidney beans and veg in a chilli-chocolate sauce, dehydrate and powder the sauce. At camp: pour boiling water into the bag, cosy 25 min, serve with corn chips (and cheese if carried).

source.title: Dehydrated Chilli Beans with Corn Chips

recipes.name: Cloudland Canyon Chili
recipes.notes: At home: mix breadcrumbs into the beef, brown it, simmer with the vegetables, beans, tomato and spices, then dehydrate (about 1½ cups dried per serving). At camp: equal volume of water to chili, bring to the boil, cozy 15 min.

recipes.name: Coconut Chickpea Curry
recipes.notes: A tinned-pantry curry; adapted with dried onion and lime powder so it needs nothing fresh. Fry the spices and tomato paste, add coconut milk and chickpeas and simmer 10-15 minutes. Serve with instant rice or flatbread.

recipes.name: Coconut Couscous Lentil Stew
recipes.notes: Carry one fresh zucchini; everything else is dry. Simmer the red lentils, zucchini, stock cube and spices for about 15 minutes, then stir in the coconut milk powder and couscous, cover and leave 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Coconut Red Lentil and Kale Stew
recipes.notes: Adapted with dried onion, stock powder and dried spinach in place of the fresh shallot, broth and kale. Bag the lentils, spices and coconut milk powder; carry a small tin of tomatoes and simmer it all for about 20 minutes.

source.title: Coconut Red Lentil Stew with Kale

recipes.name: Cook's Magic Curry Pasta
recipes.notes: Assumes 2 serves. At camp: soak mince/TVP and mushrooms; fry onion and garlic with curry powder, pepper, chutney and sultanas. Cook the quick lentil pasta, then combine with mince, mushrooms and tomato paste and warm through.

recipes.name: Corn & Bacon Casserole with Rice
recipes.notes: Group recipe for 6. At camp: boil the dried corn, peas and mushrooms until tender and thicken; fry the bacon and stir in with the cheese and reconstituted egg powder. Serve over boiled rice.

recipes.name: Couscous Vegetable Curry
recipes.notes: Assumes 2 serves. At camp: rehydrate TVP and veg, add spice mix and simmer to a thick curry with cracked cardamom and chilli; finish with sesame, almonds and coconut milk. Pour couscous into boiled water, cover 3-5 min, and serve curry on top.

recipes.name: Couscous with TVP & Tomato
recipes.notes: At camp: boil TVP in about 120 ml water for 2 min and let it rehydrate. Soak couscous, seasoning and dried tomatoes in 300 ml water 5 min, bring to the boil, cozy 5 min, then stir in the TVP. Add a splash more water if dry.

recipes.name: Creamy Cashew Mushroom Stroganoff
recipes.notes: At home cook the noodles and mushrooms and dehydrate them, and blend cashews, nutritional yeast, mustard, lemon and salt into a sauce powder. At camp rehydrate the noodles and mushrooms, then stir in the sauce mix with the olive oil.

recipes.name: Creamy Coconut Lentil and Rice Soup
recipes.notes: Adapted for the pack: instant rice, tinned brown lentils, coconut milk powder and dried veg replace the fresh and slow-cooking items. Simmer everything except the milk powder for about 10 minutes, then stir it in and season.

source.title: Creamy Curried Lentil Soup with Coconut

recipes.name: Creamy Pepperoni Pasta
recipes.notes: Assumes 2 serves and 200 g pasta. At camp: fry chopped onion and sliced pepperoni until brown, add chopped tomatoes for a minute, stir in the cream and set aside. Cook and drain pasta, then combine.

recipes.name: Creamy Pesto Angel Hair
recipes.notes: Bag the thin pasta and, separately, the pesto sauce mix, pine nuts, sun-dried tomato and parmesan. Cook the pasta in about 400 ml water, keep a little of the water, and stir in the sauce bag and olive oil.

recipes.name: Crunchy Lentil Tacos
recipes.notes: Adapted with tinned lentils and dried onion; the salad is optional. Heat the lentils with a splash of water, burrito seasoning and salsa, spoon into taco shells and top with cheese.

recipes.name: Dal Khichdi
recipes.notes: Adapted for camp with dried onion, garlic, ginger and spinach (the fresh salad is left out). Toast the seeds and spices in oil, add rice, lentils and stock, and simmer about 20 minutes until porridge-like.

recipes.name: Date and Chickpea Stew with Couscous
recipes.notes: A group dinner from the pantry, adapted with dried coriander. Soften the onion and garlic, add the warm spices, tomatoes, chickpeas and sliced dates and simmer 15 minutes, then add lemon; make the couscous separately with boiling water.

source.title: Date and Chickpea Stew with Couscous

recipes.name: Dead Simple Couscous
recipes.notes: At home: bag couscous with the soup powder. At camp: pour over about 250 ml boiling water, cover until absorbed, then fork through the olive oil.

recipes.name: Dehydrated Porcini Mushroom Risotto
recipes.notes: Adapted with extra stock instead of wine. Soak the dried mushrooms, cook the risotto at home with onion, garlic, thyme, stock and tinned chicken, stir in parmesan, then dehydrate. At camp cover with boiling water, simmer a minute and rest 10 minutes in a cosy.

recipes.name: Dehydrated Vegetable Risotto
recipes.notes: Cook a stock-based risotto with zucchini, mushrooms and peas at home (adapted: no wine), then dehydrate it. On the trail add boiling water, simmer a minute or two, rest in a cosy and finish with parmesan and olive oil.

recipes.name: Diamonds Slow Cooker Vegetarian Chilli
recipes.notes: At home: slow-cook veg, tinned tomatoes, three kinds of beans and spices (no oil), add lime, then spread on lined trays and dehydrate; weigh before and after to know the water. At camp: add boiling water, stand 15-20 min, stir in olive oil. Serves assumed 4.

recipes.name: Fifteen-Minute Beef Noodle Stir-Fry
recipes.notes: A first-night stir-fry while the steak and bagged veg are still cold. Boil the noodles, sear strips of steak with garlic in hot oil, add the veg, then toss through the noodles with soy, garlic powder, parsley and chilli.

recipes.name: Five-Spice Fire Pit Wraps
recipes.notes: A first-night campfire dinner. Rub chicken thighs (or eggplant slices) with hoisin, five spice and celery salt, grill over the fire, slice and roll in tortillas with cucumber, coriander, spring onion and bean sprouts.

source.title: How to Cook Fire Pit Five Spice Wraps

recipes.name: Five-Tin Bean Chilli
recipes.notes: A car-camp pantry chilli. Adapted for Scouts by swapping the beer for stock and using smoked paprika in place of chipotle in adobo. Soften the onion, add the tins and spices, and simmer for 20-30 minutes.

recipes.name: Ginger Garlic Jerky Noodles
recipes.notes: Assumes 2 serves (jerky cut to a sensible 60 g). Soak jerky and mushrooms from lunchtime. At camp: fry cashews and garlic in oil, add herbs, ginger, mushrooms and jerky, then water and noodles; simmer and stand briefly.

recipes.name: Green Chicken Curry with Mango and Rice
recipes.notes: Cook chicken mince in green curry paste with diced potato, mango, coconut milk and fish sauce, stir in cooked rice, reduce until dry-ish and dehydrate in thin layers. On the trail cover with boiling water and leave 15-20 minutes.

recipes.name: Green Chicken Curry with Rice Noodles
recipes.notes: At home: fry green curry paste with chicken/turkey mince, beans and cauliflower, season and dehydrate; pack coconut milk powder and rice noodles. At camp: rehydrate curry in the bag 20-25 min, soak noodles in hot water, combine.

recipes.name: Green-Lentil Chili with Vegetables
recipes.notes: At home: cook lentils, simmer with onion, garlic, spices, tomato paste, beans and tomatoes, finish with vinegar and dehydrate; dry carrots and capsicum separately. At camp: soak in 415 ml water 5 min, boil 1 min, cozy 15 min.

recipes.name: Green-Lentil Stew with Leeks & Mushrooms
recipes.notes: At home: simmer lentils with leek, onion, carrot, tomato and capsicum in stock, add pan-cooked mushrooms, then dehydrate and divide into 4 (about 1 cup dried each). At camp: soak in 315 ml water 5 min, boil 1 min, cozy 15 min.

recipes.name: Hiking Bibimbap Rice Bowl
recipes.notes: Pack a microwave-style rice pouch, freeze-dried beef and dried shiitake, plus a little jar of soy, rice vinegar, gochujang and sugar dressing. Rehydrate the beef and mushrooms in hot water, warm the rice, and top with fresh carrot, cucumber and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Hiking Pad Thai from a Meal Kit
recipes.notes: Ditch the kit box at home and nest an egg (wrapped in a cloth) in the pot. At camp boil the rice noodles until just soft, drain, scramble the egg in, then add the sauce, bean sprouts, peanuts and a squeeze of lime.

source.title: How to Cook a Succulent Hiking Pad Thai

recipes.name: Hoisin Ginger Spaghetti
recipes.notes: Adapted with dried broccoli and spring onion. Cook the spaghetti with the dried veg for the last few minutes, drain, then toss with olive oil, hoisin, ginger and toasted sesame seeds; add cubes of shelf-stable tofu if you have them.

recipes.name: Hoppin' John with Greens
recipes.notes: At home: mix cooked rice with shredded ham and canned black-eyed peas (with liquid) and dehydrate; dry the collard greens separately. At camp: soak about 115 g in 415 ml water 5 min, boil 1 min, cozy 15 min.

source.title: Hoppin' John (quick version with canned peas & greens)

recipes.name: Instant Dehydrated Laksa
recipes.notes: At home: blend and cook the spice paste, dehydrate and powder it; pack with coconut milk powder, surimi, tofu, dried veg, fried onion and egg noodles. At camp: simmer the soup mix in water, cook noodles separately, combine.

recipes.name: Jamaican Jerk Chicken with Rice & Beans
recipes.notes: At home: cook rice with black beans, lite coconut milk and jerk seasoning, then dehydrate; dry the cooked chicken separately (coconut milk shown as powder equivalent). At camp: add about 360 ml boiling water per serving, cozy 10 min.

source.title: Jamaican Jerk Chicken with Rice & Beans

recipes.name: Kabana Orzo Soup
recipes.notes: Adapted for camp with shelf-stable kabana instead of fresh Italian sausage and dried celery from a soup mix. Brown the onion and sliced kabana, add tomato paste, herbs, stock and water, then simmer the orzo in it until tender.

recipes.name: Kalina's Hiking Bean Chilli
recipes.notes: At camp: boil about 250 ml water plus what the rice needs, rehydrate dried veg and instant rice covered a few minutes, stir in taco seasoning and tomato paste, add the beans last and finish with a drizzle of oil.

source.title: Easy Hiking Meals: Hiking Bean Chilli

recipes.name: Kalina's Lup Chong Fried Rice
recipes.notes: At camp: fry the chopped Chinese sausage and set aside, cook the powdered egg and set aside, then cook instant rice with dried veg and a little extra water; combine everything with soy, spices and sesame oil.

recipes.name: Kalina's Salami Orzo Jambalaya
recipes.notes: At camp: fry chopped salami in a little oil, add Cajun spice, stock, about 375 ml water and tomato paste and bring to the boil; add orzo and dried veg, simmer 4-5 min stirring, then rest covered about 5 min.

recipes.name: Kalina's Soba Noodle Soup
recipes.notes: At camp: boil plenty of water, cook soba and dried veg together 2-3 min, stir in dashi and soy, then top with the halved hard-boiled egg and nori/furikake/sesame. The boiled egg keeps a few days unless hot.

source.title: Japanese Noodle Soup for Camping & Hiking

recipes.name: Kalina's Thai Chickpea Curry
recipes.notes: At camp: boil about 375 ml water and rehydrate the dried veg and instant rice; then stir in coconut milk powder, curry spice mix, fish sauce and chickpeas, which need no cooking.

recipes.name: Kangaroo Lentil Stew with Macadamias
recipes.notes: Adapted for Scouts with extra stock in place of the red wine. Brown lean kangaroo mince with garlic, add sweet potato, mushrooms and stock, then red lentils, cook down until thick and dehydrate. Rehydrate roughly one part water to one part meal and top with chopped macadamias.

recipes.name: Kimberley Rice
recipes.notes: At home: put everything in one zip-lock bag. At camp: soak in water as long as possible, then bring to the boil and simmer until tender.

recipes.name: Korean Chicken Camp Tacos
recipes.notes: At camp: quick-pickle sliced red onion in vinegar, sugar and salt; dress lettuce and carrot with lemon; fry chicken strips then glaze with honey, soy and garlic. Fill warmed tortillas, top with aioli and crispy shallots. Serves assumed 4.

recipes.name: Lemon Chicken Couscous with Olives
recipes.notes: At home: bag couscous, chicken, lemon powder and slices; pack olives and oil separately. At camp: add about 240 ml boiling water (for 2), wait 5 min, add olives and oil, rest 5 min more.

recipes.name: Lentil Bolognese with Fettuccine
recipes.notes: At home: cook green lentils in broth, simmer with a carrot-celery-mushroom tomato sauce, then dehydrate (about 55 g each). At camp: combine with 75 g fettuccine and 415 ml water, soak 5 min, boil, cozy 15-20 min.

recipes.name: Lentil Spaghetti Bolognese
recipes.notes: Group recipe; assumes 4 serves. At camp: fry the onion, add lentils, tomato powder, garlic, basil and water and simmer until soft. Boil and drain the pasta and top with the sauce and parmesan.

recipes.name: Loaded Cheesy Mash with Bacon
recipes.notes: Bag the instant mash with freeze-dried broccoli, a cheesy soup mix and bacon bits. Stir into boiling water off the heat until thick and top with crushed crackers.

recipes.name: Lord Howe Moroccan Lamb Stew
recipes.notes: At home: brown lamb and veg, then slow-cook with apricots, spices, tomatoes and broth, adding chickpeas near the end. Carry frozen for the first night and reheat in the pot; serve with couscous or rice. Serves assumed 6.

recipes.name: Miso Udon Noodle Soup
recipes.notes: At home: bag thick instant noodles with a flavour mix of dried mushroom, seaweed, surimi, tofu, dried miso and dashi. At camp: bring the flavour mix to the boil in the water, pour over the noodles, cover and soak about 5 min.

recipes.name: Moof's Beef Stroganoff
recipes.notes: Pack everything in one bag (soy sauce in a sachet). At camp: soak in about 590 ml water 5 min, bring to a gentle simmer for a few minutes, stirring, then cozy 8-10 min until the pasta is tender.

recipes.name: Moroccan Lamb Curry and Couscous
recipes.notes: At home: cook lamb mince with eggplant, peas, dates and Middle Eastern spices, dehydrate; pack couscous with dried coriander, lemon zest, currants and pistachios. At camp: rehydrate the lamb in a cosy 20-25 min; soak couscous in boiling water 6-7 min separately.

source.title: Dehydrated Moroccan Lamb Curry and Couscous

recipes.name: Mr. Dog's Chili Corn
recipes.notes: At home: pack the corn, beans, capsicum and dried beef in one bag and the tomato powder, bean bark and spices in a small sauce bag. At camp: add the main bag to 475 ml boiling water, stand 10 min, stir in the sauce bag and rest a few more minutes.

recipes.name: Nasi Goreng with Bacon
recipes.notes: Group recipe; assumes 3 serves. At camp: boil and drain the rice and dried veg; fry the bacon and onion, then toss everything together with the nasi goreng mix.

recipes.name: Olive Oil Camp Polenta
recipes.notes: Adapted with instant polenta, which cooks in about 5 minutes instead of 30. Whisk it into boiling salted water, keep stirring until thick, then beat in olive oil. Good under tinned beans, a stew or a pasta sauce.

recipes.name: One-Pot Lentil Pasta with Kale
recipes.notes: A first or second night meal using a jar of pasta sauce and a bunch of kale. Simmer the lentil pasta right in the sauce with about 500 ml water, add the kale for the last few minutes and finish with cheese.

recipes.name: One-Pot Thai Green Curry Rice
recipes.notes: At camp: rehydrate the soya chunks and set aside. Boil about 1.5 cups water with rice, garlic powder, curry paste and chopped veg, lid on, about 10 min. Stir in coconut milk powder and soya just before the rice is done.

recipes.name: Orzo with Chicken, Peas & Mushrooms
recipes.notes: At home: simmer orzo with mashed peas, mushrooms, onion and herbs in stock, dehydrate and split into 4. Add dried chicken to each bag and pack milk and cheese powder separately. At camp: soak in 360 ml water 5 min, boil 1 min, cozy 15 min, stir in powders.

recipes.name: Paddy's Tasty Stew
recipes.notes: Serves 2. Soak dried veg about an hour (or from lunch). At camp: add chopped corned beef or smoked pork, stew 30 min, then thicken with potato flakes (or add dumplings) and simmer briefly.

recipes.name: Pasta Primavera with Capers (Dehydrated)
recipes.notes: Dry the zucchini, squash, cherry tomatoes, capers and parsley at home and bag with small pasta, butter powder and herbs. At camp simmer the bag contents until tender, drain a little, then add olive oil and parmesan.

recipes.name: Pasta with Mettwurst Cheese Sauce
recipes.notes: At camp: rehydrate mushrooms and onion; fry mettwurst in butter, add the veg, then stir in milk powder and cornflour mixed with a cup of water plus the cheese until thick. Cook spaghetti in about 1 L water, drain and pour sauce over.

recipes.name: Pasta with Red Sauce & Beef
recipes.notes: At home: bag pasta spirals with dried beef mince, dried capsicum, tomato, onion, mushrooms, carrot, tomato powder and herbs. At camp: soak in 480 ml water 5 min, simmer gently about 7 min, then cozy 8-10 min.

source.title: Pasta with Red Sauce & Ground Beef

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Kidney Beans
recipes.notes: Adapted with tinned kidney beans and dried capsicum. Fry onion and garlic in oil, add cumin, cayenne, capsicum and tomato sauce, then the beans; simmer 15 minutes and stir through peanut butter and lemon juice. Serve with rice or flatbread.

recipes.name: Peanut Miso Udon
recipes.notes: Assumes 2 serves. At camp: put everything into the water from the start, stir until boiling, then cover and stand until the noodles are soft.

recipes.name: Peanut Noodle Pad Thai
recipes.notes: Assumes 1 serving. At home: bag noodles with all dry ingredients. At camp: add about 270 ml boiling water, stir, seal 10-15 min until noodles are tender; add sriracha to taste.

recipes.name: Peanut Rice and Lentil Soup
recipes.notes: Adapted with instant brown rice and dried veg. Simmer the rice, lentils and veg in stock and water for about 20 minutes, then stir in tomato paste, peanut butter, soy, nutritional yeast and a few drops of hot sauce; top with peanuts.

recipes.name: Penne Pasta "Lasagna"
recipes.notes: At home: combine everything in a boil bag. At camp: add about 300 ml boiling water (for 2), stir well to spread the cheese, seal 10-15 min. Many hikers eat the whole bag as one serve.

recipes.name: Persian Couscous with Nuts & Fruit
recipes.notes: At home: combine everything in a bag. At camp: add about 160 ml boiling water (for 2), stir, cover and stand 10 min, then fluff.

recipes.name: Persian Eggplant Burghul
recipes.notes: For 3-4 people (4 serves assumed). At home: mix everything except currants. At camp: soak in warm water, bring to the boil and cook until nearly soft, then add currants.

recipes.name: Pork Chow Mein Stir-Fry
recipes.notes: At home: stir-fry the vegetables in a thickened soy-oyster sauce, mix with dehydrated pulled pork, dry. At camp: rehydrate the meat and veg in a cosy 20-25 min, cook noodles in the pot, top with cashews.

source.title: Dehydrated Chinese Pork Chow Mein Stir-Fry

recipes.name: Prawn and Capsicum Paella (Dehydrated)
recipes.notes: Cook the paella rice with saffron-style seasoning, capsicum, capers and parsley at home and dry it together with the cooked prawns and seafood sticks. At camp simmer in water for a few minutes, rest, then add olive oil and a sachet of olives.

recipes.name: Quick Kabana Stew
recipes.notes: Assumes 1 serving. At camp: boil the water, add chopped kabana, butter, dried peas and onion, simmer a few minutes, then stir in potato flakes to thicken. Eat from the billy.

recipes.name: Quick Noodle Stew
recipes.notes: At camp: bring nuts and dried veg to the boil in 400-500 ml water, then add the soup mix and noodles and cook until the noodles are soft. Hungry walkers may want two noodle packs.

recipes.name: Quinoa Black Bean Burrito Bowl
recipes.notes: Cook the quinoa with fire-roasted tomatoes, black beans, capsicum, corn and spices at home and dehydrate. Rehydrate with boiling water in camp, then add oil, lime powder and crushed corn chips on top.

recipes.name: Ramen-Spiced Quinoa
recipes.notes: Keep the flavour sachets when you use plain noodles elsewhere; they season this quinoa. Simmer quinoa, dried veg and a sachet or two in the water for 15 minutes, then rest covered and top with peanuts.

recipes.name: Red Curry Peanut Rice
recipes.notes: One bag holds the instant rice, dried veg, freeze-dried chicken, coconut milk powder, curry powder, peanut powder, peanuts, lime powder and salt. At camp add about 300 ml boiling water and the oil, stir, and cover for 10 minutes.

source.title: Thai Red Curry Rice with Peanut Coconut Sauce

recipes.name: Red Lentil Curry with Basmati Rice
recipes.notes: At home: cook the spiced red lentils, blend smooth and dry into bark (batch makes about 15 portions of ¼ cup). Per meal pack ¼ cup bark, ½ cup dried basmati and ½ cup dried veg. At camp: soak in 300 ml water 5 min, boil 1 min, cozy 10-15 min.

source.title: Red Lentil Curry with Basmati Rice & Vegetables

recipes.name: Red Lentil Marinara Pasta
recipes.notes: Simmer the red lentils in tomatoes and stock with garlic and herbs at home, then dry the sauce. Pack it with small pasta; at camp cook the pasta, add the sauce and a little more water, and top with parmesan and olive oil.

recipes.name: Red Lentil Sloppy Joes
recipes.notes: Best on the first night while the buns, onion and capsicum are fresh. Fry the veg, add tomato paste, garlic, lentils and water and simmer about 20 minutes, then season with mustard, maple, vinegar, Worcestershire and chilli and pile onto buns.

recipes.name: Red Lentil Sweet Potato Dal (Dehydrated)
recipes.notes: Cook the dal at home with mustard seed, coriander, turmeric, garlic, ginger, tomato, diced sweet potato and kale, then dry it in thin sheets. At camp add boiling water, simmer briefly and let it stand until soft; good with instant rice.

recipes.name: Rotini & Beef with Ratatouille
recipes.notes: At home: cook a saucy ratatouille with fennel and herbs, dehydrate; also dry cooked beef mince. Bag 50 g rotini, 30 g ratatouille and 30 g beef each. At camp: soak in 355 ml water 5 min, boil 1 min, cozy 15-20 min.

recipes.name: Salmon Risotto
recipes.notes: At camp: fry chopped onion, then the rice until lightly browned. Add 500 ml water and peas and simmer until nearly cooked, stir in the soup mix and simmer, then fold in salmon and lemon. Top with pepper and parmesan.

recipes.name: Salsa Soup with Corn Dumplings
recipes.notes: Two bags: a soup base of tomato powder, onion flakes, garlic, herbs, cumin, chilli and dried capsicum, and a dumpling mix of polenta, flour, milk powder, baking powder and parmesan. Simmer the soup, stir a little water into the dumpling mix and drop spoonfuls in to steam for about 10 minutes with the lid on.

recipes.name: Satay Spaghetti
recipes.notes: At home: mix soup powder and spices in a bag. At camp: boil the veg; mix a cup of boiling water with the soup and peanut butter for sauce. Cook and drain spaghetti, toss with the sauce and serve with the veg.

recipes.name: Saucy Peanut Soba Noodles
recipes.notes: Carry the soba noodles plus a small jar of peanut butter mixed at home with soy, sesame oil, sriracha and chilli. Boil and drain the noodles, keeping a splash of the water, and toss them through the sauce.

recipes.name: Senor Glenn's Mexican Beef & Rice
recipes.notes: Pack the cheese, milk and taco powders in a small separate bag. At camp: soak rice, beef, beans and veg in 300 ml water 5 min, boil 1 min, stir in the powders, cozy 10 min.

recipes.name: Sierra's Hot Stuff Burghul
recipes.notes: At home: bag burghul, onion and spices; carry cheese and oil. At camp: pour 1 cup boiling water into the bag, then stir through the oil and small pieces of cheese until melted.

recipes.name: Sierra's Italian Burghul
recipes.notes: Assumes 2 serves. At home: combine burghul, pine nuts, onion, tomato, stock and herbs in a heat-proof bag; carry oil and parmesan separately. At camp: pour on 1.5 cups boiling water, add oil and cheese, cover 10 min.

recipes.name: Sierra's Superior Spuds
recipes.notes: At home: bag potato flakes and milk powder; pack bacon, cheese and oil separately. At camp: pour 125 ml boiling water over everything except spices, stir, stand 1 min, then season.

recipes.name: Simple One-Pot Tomato Pasta
recipes.notes: Adapted with dried onion, garlic powder and stock powder. Put the pasta, a tin of tomatoes, stock, herbs and about 300 ml water in one pot, simmer until the pasta is tender and the sauce has thickened, then top with parmesan.

recipes.name: Slower Hiking Beef Vindaloo
recipes.notes: At home: marinate and slow-cook beef in vindaloo paste, dehydrate meat and powdered sauce; par-cook and dry rice separately. At camp: rehydrate meat in a cosy 20-25 min, rehydrate rice in the pot, stir in a little oil or ghee.

recipes.name: Slower Hiking Bolognese
recipes.notes: At home: cook a thick veg-packed mince sauce, mix with par-cooked pasta, dehydrate and powder any runny sauce. At camp: add boiling water to the bag, stir, cosy 25 min, then add olive oil and parmesan.

recipes.name: Slower Hiking Tuna Mornay
recipes.notes: At home: fry onion, corn, peas and tuna with lemon and herbs, mix with par-cooked pasta and dehydrate; pack milk powder and mornay sachet separately. At camp: add boiling water, cosy 20 min, stir in powders and parmesan, rest 10 min. Serves estimated.

recipes.name: Smoked Fish with Parsley Sauce & Mash
recipes.notes: Assumes 1 serving. At camp: make the parsley sauce with reconstituted milk and simmer 2 min; boil the dried veg and use the water for the mash; warm the fish in a pan and pour the sauce over.

source.title: ABW Smoked Fish and Parsley Sauce with Vegies

recipes.name: Smoky Mountain Beef with Diced Potatoes
recipes.notes: At home: cook lean beef with spring onion, capsicum, mushrooms, carrot, celery, tomato paste, breadcrumbs and smoky spices; dehydrate with precooked diced potato. At camp: soak in 300 ml water 5 min, boil 1 min, rest 20 min.

source.title: Smoky Mountain Beef Skillet with Diced Potatoes

recipes.name: Southwest Beef & Rice
recipes.notes: At home: bag dried beef mince, instant rice, dried veg, tomato flakes, cheese powder and spices together. At camp: soak in 415 ml water 5 min, simmer gently about 7 min, then cozy 8-10 min.

recipes.name: Southwestern Bean & Rice Burrito
recipes.notes: At home: bag the dry filling; carry tortillas separately. At camp: add about 270 ml boiling water (for 2), stir, seal 10 min, stir again and fill the tortillas.

recipes.name: Spaghetti Mettwurst
recipes.notes: At camp: soak the onion, fry the chopped mettwurst, cook and drain the spaghetti, then toss everything together with parmesan and oregano.

recipes.name: Spicy Dhal with Pan Roti
recipes.notes: Adapted with dried onion. Pack the roti dry mix (wholemeal flour, baking powder, salt) separately from the lentils, spices, raisins and cashews. At camp simmer the dhal with tomato paste and water, and meanwhile mix, roll and dry-fry the roti.

recipes.name: Stuffed Turkey Loaf Feast
recipes.notes: At home: bake a turkey mince loaf with bread stuffing, cube and dehydrate; dry mixed veg and sweet potato. At camp: soak 65 g loaf and 35 g veg in 240 ml water 5 min, boil 1 min, cozy 30 min; make the mash with 120 ml boiled water.

recipes.name: Sun-Dried Tomato Pesto Macaroni
recipes.notes: Assumes 2 serves. At camp: bring macaroni to the boil in about 1 L water, take off heat, cover and stand until soft. Toss with chopped sun-dried tomato, pine nuts, paste, oregano, garlic and oil; top with cheese.

recipes.name: Sun-Dried Tomato Pesto Penne
recipes.notes: Cook and dehydrate the penne at home so it rehydrates in minutes, then bag it with diced sun-dried tomato, pine nuts, basil, garlic and salt. At camp cover with hot water for about 10 minutes (or cold-soak), drain, and toss with parmesan and olive oil.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato Peanut Stew (Dehydrated)
recipes.notes: Cook the onion, sweet potato, tomatoes, chickpeas, kale and spices into a thick stew at home and dehydrate it. Pack peanut butter sachets and crushed peanuts separately; rehydrate the stew in boiling water and stir them in.

recipes.name: Taco Beef Mac & Cheese
recipes.notes: At home: dry cooked beef mince and capsicum/onion/mushroom/tomato; bag with macaroni; pack cheese, milk and taco powders separately. At camp: soak in 300 ml water 5 min, boil 2 min, stir in powders off the heat, cozy 10 min.

recipes.name: Teriyaki Chicken & Rice
recipes.notes: At home: mix rice, chicken, fruit, veg and sauce powders in a boil bag. At camp: add about 480 ml boiling water (for 2), stir at once, seal 15 min, stirring now and then.

recipes.name: Thai Coconut Chicken & Rice
recipes.notes: At home: combine everything in a boil bag. At camp: add about 240 ml boiling water (for 2), stir, seal and rest 10 min.

recipes.name: Thai Peanut Noodles with Chicken & Veggies
recipes.notes: At home: toss cooked linguine in a peanut-powder, soy, honey, lime and sriracha sauce, dehydrate; dry chicken mince and vegetables. At camp: soak in 415 ml water 5 min, boil 1 min, cozy 15 min.

source.title: Thai Peanut Noodles with Chicken & Veggies

recipes.name: Tomato and Bean Minestrone
recipes.notes: At home: cook vegetables, tomato paste and cannellini into a thick minestrone, dehydrate with par-cooked pasta and powder the sauce. At camp: add boiling water, cosy 20-25 min, then stir in olive oil and parmesan.

recipes.name: Trail Turkey Dinner
recipes.notes: At home: bag the stuffing mix, potato flakes, dried chicken, cranberries, gravy powder and herbs together. At camp: add 415 ml boiling water, stir, cover and rest 5-10 min.

recipes.name: Tuna Kedgeree
recipes.notes: At camp: fry onion in margarine, add rice and toast lightly. Add water and peas, simmer 10 min, then stir in the soup mix and tuna liquid and simmer until cooked. Finish with tuna and lemon juice.

recipes.name: Tuna Mac & Cheese with Veggies
recipes.notes: At home: dehydrate a tin of tuna and mixed vegetables; bag with precooked-dried macaroni; pack cheese and milk powders separately. At camp: soak in 450 ml water 5 min, boil 1 min, stir in powders, cozy 15 min.

recipes.name: Turkey Chili
recipes.notes: At home: simmer diced roast turkey with onion, capsicum, garlic, tomatoes, kidney beans, tomato sauce, broth and chilli spices until thick, then dehydrate. At camp: add about 400 ml boiling water, stir and cozy 20 min.

recipes.name: Turkey Massaman Curry with Chickpeas
recipes.notes: Brown turkey mince in massaman paste, add potato, chickpeas and coconut milk, simmer, mix through cooked rice and dehydrate. Carry chopped roasted cashews separately and stir them in after rehydrating.

recipes.name: Unstuffed Peppers with TVP
recipes.notes: At home: bag dried rice, TVP and dried capsicum; pack tomato sauce leather or powder separately. At camp: soak everything in 355 ml water 5 min, boil 1 min, cozy about 15 min.

recipes.name: Upside Down Shepherd's Pie
recipes.notes: Pack the potato mix and the meat mix separately. At camp: make the mash with 240 ml boiling water and set aside in a bowl, then soak the beef, veg and seasoning in about 160 ml water, boil 1-2 min, cozy and spoon over the mash.

recipes.name: Vegan Cashew Mac and Cheese
recipes.notes: Assumes about 3 serves (~120 g pasta each). At home: blend cashews fine and mix with yeast and spices. At camp: cook macaroni, leaving a little extra water, then stir in the sauce powder until creamy.

recipes.name: Veggie Camp Fajitas
recipes.notes: A first-night dinner on a camp hotplate. Fry strips of onion and capsicum, then the sliced mushrooms, toss with fajita seasoning and pile into tortillas with tomato, leaves, salsa and sour cream.

recipes.name: Warrumbungles Moroccan Chicken and Couscous
recipes.notes: At home: roast pumpkin and onion. At camp: pan-fry spice-and-flour-coated thighs about 15 min, glazing with honey at the end; soak couscous in boiling stock with carrot and currants, toss with the veg, pomegranate and spinach, serve with lemon yoghurt.

source.title: Warrumbungles Honey Glazed Moroccan Chicken with Couscous Salad

recipes.name: Yellow Mung Dal & Rice
recipes.notes: At home: cook mung dal with onion, carrot, capsicum, turmeric and spices in water or vegetable broth, then dehydrate. At camp: combine ¾ cup dal and ¼ cup instant rice with about 355 ml water, boil 1 min, cozy 15 min.

recipes.name: Almond Butter Rice Crispy Slice
recipes.notes: Make at home: warm almond butter, rice syrup and coconut oil, stir through puffed rice, almonds, hemp seeds, coconut and salt, press into a tin and top with melted chocolate. Cut 12 pieces once firm.

source.title: Almond Butter Brown Rice Crispy Treats

recipes.name: Aloha Macadamia Trail Mix
recipes.notes: Macadamias, coconut flakes, dried pineapple and white chocolate chips in a snack bag. Very calorie-dense, so a little goes a long way on a long day.

recipes.name: Apple Pie Jaffle
recipes.notes: Mix tinned apple with sultanas, cinnamon and maple syrup and spoon it between buttered bread in the jaffle iron. Toast until golden and let it cool a minute; the filling gets very hot.

source.title: 3 Jaffle Recipes to Try at Your Next Campout

recipes.name: Apricot Coconut Crumb Bars
recipes.notes: A sturdy baked slice for car camps and day walks. Simmer the apricots with sugar and water into a jam, press half the coconut-oil crumb into a tin, spread the jam, top with the rest and bake. Cuts into 24 squares.

recipes.name: Bag-Shaken Camping Ice Cream
recipes.notes: At camp: seal milk, sugar and vanilla in a small zip bag, put it inside a larger bag of ice and 6-8 tbsp rock salt, and shake about 5 min. Needs an esky with ice. Makes one big scoop.

recipes.name: Banana Choc Walnut Oat Bars
recipes.notes: Make at home: melt coconut oil, honey, brown sugar, salt and vanilla, pour over oats, puffed rice, walnuts, banana chips and choc chips, press into a lined tin and bake. Cool completely and cut 12 bars.

recipes.name: Banana Seed Muesli Bars
