recipes.notes: At home: mix mashed banana and vanilla with oats, dried fruit, nuts, seeds, cinnamon and salt, press into a lined dish and bake 22-26 min. Cool completely, slice about 12 bars; keeps a week chilled or freezes well.

recipes.name: Banana-Mango Coconut Pudding
recipes.notes: At home: blend mango with a little banana and dry into a leather. At camp: warm 300 ml water with the torn leather, stir in coconut milk powder and keep stirring until smooth and hot.

source.title: Banana-Mango Fruit Pudding with Coconut Milk

recipes.name: Banana-Pineapple Granola Bars
recipes.notes: At home: mash banana with pineapple juice, fold in crushed pineapple, granola and toasted seeds, nuts and coconut. Spread 1 cm thick, dehydrate, cutting into 8 bars once firm.

recipes.name: Berry-Chocolate Chip Granola Bars
recipes.notes: At home: grate apples, blend some with raspberries and juice, then mix in granola, honey, choc chips, toasted seeds, walnuts and cinnamon. Spread 1 cm thick, dehydrate and cut into 8 bars halfway through.

recipes.name: Billy-Boiled Fruit Pudding
recipes.notes: Assumes 2 serves. Mix flour, sugar and salt, rub in butter and dried fruit and bind to a dry dough. Tie in a floured cloth bag with room to swell and keep at the boil in a billy about 30 min.

recipes.name: Blueberry Coconut Almond Bars
recipes.notes: Bake at home: toast the oats, then combine with puffed rice, salt, dried blueberries, coconut and almonds and bind with warmed rice syrup, almond butter and vanilla. Press, chill and cut 12 bars.

recipes.name: Breadcrumb Apple Pie
recipes.notes: At camp: warm the dried apples, raisins, sugar and cinnamon in 120 ml water until soft, then stir in the breadcrumbs to soak up the juices.

recipes.name: Brownie Batter Chickpea Dip
recipes.notes: At home blend chickpeas with cocoa, sugar, vanilla, salt and a little water, dry the paste, and grind it to a powder; split into four bags. On the trail stir in about 60 ml cold water and coconut oil and eat with a squeeze pack of almond butter.

recipes.name: Camp Chocolate Fondue
recipes.notes: Adapted with UHT cream. Melt chopped chocolate gently with the cream in a small pot, stirring all the time, and dip biscuits, marshmallows, banana or dried fruit.

recipes.name: Campfire Baked Apple
recipes.notes: Campfire only. Core the apple leaving the base closed, stuff with raisins, nuts, brown sugar, butter and cinnamon, wrap in heavy foil and bake in hot coals 20-30 min.

recipes.name: Campfire Banana Boats
recipes.notes: Slit a banana along its length in the skin, stuff it with chocolate and mini marshmallows, wrap in foil and sit it on the coals for 5-10 minutes. Crumble a digestive biscuit over the top to eat.

recipes.name: Campfire Chai Latte
recipes.notes: Adapted for camp with ground spices and milk powder. Simmer the spices and tea bags in water for 5 minutes, take out the bags, whisk in milk powder and maple syrup and pour into mugs.

recipes.name: Campfire Peach Crumble Pouch
recipes.notes: At home: bag the crumble mix (oats, flour, pecans, sugar, coconut oil, spices). At camp: layer peaches and crumble in a sealed foil pouch and cook in the coals 15-20 min until bubbling.

recipes.name: Campfire Spiced Popcorn
recipes.notes: Heat the oil in a lidded pot over the stove or coals, add the kernels, cover and shake until the popping slows. Toss with salt and a bagged seasoning such as cinnamon sugar or parmesan and garlic.

recipes.name: Chef Glenn's Fig Energy Bars
recipes.notes: At home: soften the figs in a little boiling water, then blend with toasted oats, chopped pecans, sunflower seeds, grated dark chocolate, cinnamon and salt. Press, cut into 6 bars and dry until firm.

source.title: Chef Glenn's Best Energy Bar Recipe

recipes.name: Chilli Lime Fruit Leathers
recipes.notes: Blend watermelon, mango and pineapple with lime juice and chilli-lime seasoning, spread thin on lined dehydrator trays and dry until no longer tacky. Roll in baking paper; four rolls make a snack.

recipes.name: Chocolate Chip Oat Bites
recipes.notes: Makes 24 small bites; four bites is a serve. Mix oats, choc chips, brown sugar, chia and salt with peanut butter, mashed banana and rice syrup, roll into balls, bake until firm, and cool fully before bagging.

recipes.name: Chocolate Peanut Butter Shake
recipes.notes: Adapted for Australia with Milo in place of the US breakfast drink sachet. Shake the milk powder, peanut butter powder and Milo with about 240 ml cold water in a bottle; good as a recovery drink or a rushed breakfast.

recipes.name: Classic Campfire S'mores
recipes.notes: Toast a marshmallow on a long stick over the coals and squash it between two digestive biscuits with a square of dark chocolate. Use vegan marshmallows and dark chocolate for a dairy-free version.

recipes.name: Classic GORP Trail Mix
recipes.notes: Good old raisins and peanuts with cashews and cranberries. Mix a big batch and bag half-cup serves; add some chocolate for a sweeter version.

recipes.name: Coconut Pineapple Rice Pudding
recipes.notes: A base-camp dessert. Simmer short-grain rice in a tin of coconut milk plus a little water with vanilla, sugar, salt and star anise, stirring often, until soft and creamy; top with tinned pineapple and banana.

recipes.name: Crunchy Fruits with Custard
recipes.notes: Assumes 1 serving. At camp: soak apple and sultanas in a cup of hot water; crush the biscuits over the softened fruit and pour custard (made with hot water) on top.

recipes.name: Cucumber Lime Electrolyte Refresher
recipes.notes: Juice half a cucumber and two peeled limes and mix with coconut water; serve chilled after a hot hike. Best made at base camp or home with a juicer.

source.title: Homemade Hydration Drinks: Cucumber and Lime Electrolyte Refresher

recipes.name: Dairy-Free Peanut Protein Bars
recipes.notes: At home: stir warmed peanut butter with honey, vanilla and protein powder, press into a lined tin, top with choc chips and salt, chill overnight and cut 6 bars. They soften in heat, so carry in a cool spot.

recipes.name: Date Fig Nut Bars
recipes.notes: Blitz the dates, figs, almonds, hazelnuts, oats and sesame seeds with a little syrup at home, press into a block and cut six bars. They keep well without refrigeration.

recipes.name: Dehydrated Char Siu Pulled Pork
recipes.notes: At home: slow-roast pork shoulder in char siu style sauce, shred finely and dehydrate. Eat dry as a snack (about 25 g each), or add to noodles or rice: cover with water, bring to the boil and cosy 10 min.

recipes.name: Diamonds Coconut Date Balls
recipes.notes: At home: soak dates and chia, then process with almond meal, coconut, coconut oil and cacao; roll tablespoon balls in coconut. About 20 balls; one serve = 2 balls.

recipes.name: Diamonds Power-Up Protein Balls
recipes.notes: At home: combine oats, seeds and chopped nuts, mix in peanut butter and honey (a dash of water if dry), roll tablespoon balls and chill to firm. About 12 balls; one serve = 2 balls.

recipes.name: DIY Hot Cocoa Mix
recipes.notes: Whisk milk powder, cocoa, sugar, cornflour and salt together at home and portion about 4 tablespoons per mug. Stir into 250 ml hot water.

recipes.name: Dried Fruit & Custard
recipes.notes: Assumes 1 serving. At home: bag quick custard powder and dried fruit separately. At camp: soak the fruit in water to soften, make the custard with hot water and pour over.

recipes.name: Easy Cinnamon Apple Cake
recipes.notes: At home: fold chopped apple into a simple oil and yoghurt batter, top with cinnamon sugar and bake 30-35 min, then drizzle with glaze. Carry whole in a tin to share on the trail; about 10 slices.

recipes.name: Festive Cranberry Trail Mix
recipes.notes: Toss everything together and divide into four snack bags. Yoghurt-coated sultanas and chocolate can soften in hot weather, so keep them near the top of the pack away from the sun.

recipes.name: Figgy Pudding with Pecans
recipes.notes: At home: cook figs and oats with banana, maple syrup and lemon, blend and dry into one fruit leather. At camp: tear half a leather into 240 ml water with a handful of pecans, boil, then cozy 20-30 min. Also good eaten dry.

source.title: Backpacker's Figgy Pudding with Pecans (Banana-Fig Fruit Leather)

recipes.name: Freeze-Dried Apple Crisp
recipes.notes: Bag the freeze-dried apple with brown sugar, cinnamon and cloves, and the granola and walnuts separately. Pour a little boiling water over the apple mix, wait a few minutes, then top with the crunchy bag.

recipes.name: Freeze-Dried Blueberry Crisp
recipes.notes: Carry the freeze-dried blueberries with the sugar, and the granola in a separate bag so it stays crunchy. Add a splash of hot water to the berries, let them go jammy, then pile the granola on top.

recipes.name: Hot Cross Damper
recipes.notes: Rub butter into the spiced self-raising flour and sugar, add milk, egg and sultanas to make a soft dough, and bake in a camp oven on the coals (or a home oven). Brush with a golden-syrup glaze while warm; serves eight.

recipes.name: Hudson Bay Bread
recipes.notes: At home: grind part of the oats to flour, mix with melted butter, sugar, honey and syrup, nuts, raisins, choc chips and vanilla; press into trays, bake and cut into 30 dense bars.

recipes.name: Jo's Moist Carrot Cake
recipes.notes: At home: combine the dry mix with carrot, oil, eggs and banana and bake slowly about 1 hour; ice with lemony cream cheese and walnuts. Slice for a cuppa on the hike; keep iced cake cool. About 12 slices.

recipes.name: Larapinta Dutch Oven Dumplings
recipes.notes: At camp: simmer water, sugar, golden syrup and butter in a camp oven or pot; rub butter into SR flour, add egg and milk for a stiff dough, drop about 8 balls into the syrup and cook 10-12 min.

recipes.name: Lemon Myrtle Damper on a Stick
recipes.notes: Adapted with water (or rehydrated milk powder) instead of fresh milk. Mix self-raising flour, salt and dried lemon myrtle with the liquid into a soft dough, wind it around green sticks and turn slowly over gentle coals until golden and hollow-sounding.

recipes.name: Macadamia White Choc Biscuits (GF)
recipes.notes: At home: cream butter and sugars with egg, vanilla and a macadamia paste, mix in gluten-free flour and bicarb, then chopped nuts and white choc; bake tablespoon scoops 10-12 min. Makes about 24.

recipes.name: Macaroni Surprise Dessert
recipes.notes: Assumes 2 serves. At camp: simmer the macaroni in water until just cooked, take off the heat and stir in milk powder, sultanas, sugar and Milo, adding a little water if needed.

recipes.name: Maple Canadian Trail Mix
recipes.notes: At home: toss nuts, coconut and pepitas with maple syrup and salt, bake low until golden, cool and break up, then add chocolate-covered fruit balls. About 6 handfuls; chocolate quantity estimated.

recipes.name: Maple Glazed Nut and Cherry Mix
recipes.notes: Toss the almonds, pecans, coconut and pepitas with maple syrup and salt and bake at home until glazed. Once cold, mix in chocolate chips and dried cherries and bag in half-cup serves.

recipes.name: No-Bake Peanut Honey Oat Bars
recipes.notes: Warm the peanut butter and honey just enough to mix, stir in the oats, salt, vanilla, mini choc chips and pepitas, press into a lined tin and refrigerate before cutting eight bars. Wrap each one for the pack.

recipes.name: Nutella Hot Chocolate
recipes.notes: Adapted for camp with powdered milk. Heat about 250 ml water, whisk in the milk powder and a spoon of Nutella until smooth, and float a toasted marshmallow on top.

recipes.name: Nutritional Yeast Stovetop Popcorn
recipes.notes: Heat the oil in a lidded pot, add the kernels, cover and shake as it pops. Toss with melted butter, salt and nutritional yeast for a cheesy flavour; a good evening activity around the fire.

recipes.name: Orange Sesame Roasted Almonds
recipes.notes: Roast the almonds at home with sesame and grapeseed oils, orange zest, soy and salt until fragrant. Cool and bag about 1/4 cup per serve.

recipes.name: Orange-Mango Spoon Smoothie
recipes.notes: At home: blend mango with orange and dry into a leather; pack with dried berries and dried mango. On trail: shake everything with 415 ml cold water in a sealed jar and wait at least 1 h, shaking again before eating.

recipes.name: PB and Jam Oat Bars
recipes.notes: Make at home: warm the jam, peanut butter, brown sugar and coconut oil, stir in the oats, salt and chopped peanuts, press into a lined tin, bake briefly and chill before cutting into six bars.

recipes.name: Peanut Banana Bread Cookies
recipes.notes: At home: mash banana with peanut butter and cinnamon, fold in oats and choc chips, scoop and bake about 15 min. Cool fully and pack in a sealed container; makes about 18.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Banana Bagel
recipes.notes: Bagels survive a pack far better than sliced bread. Split, spread thickly with peanut butter and top with banana slices.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Oat Energy Balls
recipes.notes: Makes about 20 balls; four make a serve. Stir everything together at home, chill until firm enough to roll, and pack in a hard container so they keep their shape in hot weather.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Protein Bites
recipes.notes: The energy-ball mix with two scoops of protein powder added. Roll about 20 at home and pack four per serve in a small container.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Spread (from Powder)
recipes.notes: Carry peanut butter powder and oil sachets. At camp: stir about 40 ml water per serve and the oil into the powder until spreadable; use on wraps or crackers.

recipes.name: Peanut Choc No-Bake Cookies
recipes.notes: Makes 24 small cookies; four make a serve. Stir together at home, scoop onto a tray and set in the fridge, then pack in a hard container.

recipes.name: Pina Colada Fruit Roll-Ups
recipes.notes: Blend tinned pineapple with lemon juice, spread thinly on lined trays, sprinkle with coconut and dry until leathery. Cut into strips and roll in baking paper; three strips is a serve.

recipes.name: Pineapple-Coconut Fruit Leather
recipes.notes: At home: blend a can of crushed pineapple, stir through the coconut, spread thinly on lined dehydrator trays and dry until no longer tacky. Roll in baking paper.

recipes.name: S'mores Oat Bars
recipes.notes: At home simmer chopped dates with water, maple and chia into a paste, then mix with oats, crushed digestive biscuits, mini marshmallows and dark chocolate. Press into a tin, bake until set and cut into six bars.

recipes.name: Seeded Sourdough Crackers
recipes.notes: At home: knead refreshed sourdough starter with flour, semolina, oil, seeds and spices, roll into thin slabs and bake slowly until crisp. Carry for track lunches (about four). Flour includes the flour in 150 g refreshed starter.

recipes.name: Spiced Apple Fruit Leather
recipes.notes: At home: cook the apples into a spiced applesauce with orange juice and zest, blend, spread on lined trays and dehydrate into 3 leathers. Eat as is, or tear up and stir into a cup of water for instant applesauce.

recipes.name: Spiced Mexican Hot Cocoa
recipes.notes: Adapted for Scouts with the alcohol left out. Heat the water and stir in hot chocolate sachets with cinnamon and a small pinch of cayenne for a gentle warming kick.

recipes.name: Spicy Maple Cereal Snack Mix
recipes.notes: A big batch for a whole troop. At home toss puffed cereal, pretzels and cashews with melted butter, maple syrup, soy and chilli sauce, bake low until crisp, cool and bag about 3/4 cup per serve.

recipes.name: Sweet and Salty Popcorn Granola
recipes.notes: Pop the corn in a lidded billy over the fire. Toast the nuts, seeds and coconut in a pan with the rest of the oil, maple syrup, salt and cinnamon until sticky, let it cool, then mix with the popcorn and chopped chocolate. Split into five snack bags.

source.title: Popcorn Granola: The Perfect Snack Attack

recipes.name: Sweet and Spicy Sriracha Nut Mix
recipes.notes: Coat the cashews, peanuts, puffed rice cereal and pretzels in a warm mix of honey, sriracha, oil and soy, bake at home until crisp, cool and bag. Half a cup is one serve.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato-Apple-Fig Fruit Leather
recipes.notes: At home: simmer figs, apple and oats, blend with baked sweet potato and maple syrup, spread on a dehydrator tray and dry until leathery. Cut into three trail portions.

recipes.name: Toasted Oat & Almond Energy Bars
recipes.notes: At home: blend the dates with maple syrup and nut butter into a paste, fold in toasted oats and chopped almonds, press into a lined tin, chill and cut into about 16 bars.

recipes.name: Trail Angel Cake
recipes.notes: At home: dry angel food cake into crumbs. At camp: warm the dried strawberries gently in 120 ml water about 10 min; make a chocolate sauce from the cocoa mix and a few teaspoons of water; layer over the cake crumbs.

recipes.name: Trail Mud Pie
recipes.notes: Mix the milk powder with 120 ml cold water, whisk in the chocolate pudding mix and let it set about 5 min, then stir in the crushed chocolate biscuits and nuts.

recipes.name: Trail Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
recipes.notes: At camp: warm the dried pineapple in 120 ml water for about 10 min. Mix milk powder with 120 ml cold water, whisk in the pudding mix and let it set 5 min. Layer cake crumbs, pudding and pineapple; top with coconut.

recipes.name: Trailside Tiramisu
recipes.notes: Mix vanilla instant pudding with milk powder, instant coffee, cocoa and cinnamon at home and split into four bags with some plain biscuits. Whisk each serve with about 90 ml cold water, let it set a few minutes and layer with the crumbled biscuits.

recipes.name: Vegan Chocolate Raspberry Slice
recipes.notes: At home: press a processed oat, coconut, almond, date and cocoa base, spread with a chia-raspberry jam, top with melted chocolate and toasted coconut, then chill. Cut about 16 bars and keep cool in the pack.

recipes.name: Walnut Date Energy Balls
recipes.notes: Makes about 18; three balls per serve. At home pulse the walnuts and dates with oat flour, almond butter, vanilla, salt and a little water, fold in the choc chips and roll.

recipes.name: Warm Mixed Berry Crumble
recipes.notes: Bag the freeze-dried berries with butter powder, sugar, cornflour, cinnamon and lemon powder; carry a crushed digestive biscuit and the coconut oil separately. Add hot water a little at a time until it turns into a thick compote, then sprinkle the crumbs on top.

recipes.name: Watermelon Electrolyte Booster
recipes.notes: Blend seeded watermelon (a quarter melon, ~1 kg flesh assumed) with two large glasses of coconut water and a pinch of salt. A post-hike recovery drink for about 3 glasses.

source.title: Homemade Hydration Drinks: Watermelon Electrolyte Booster

recipes.name: White Choc Coconut Pudding
recipes.notes: Divide white chocolate instant pudding, milk powder and coconut into four bags with some crumbled biscuits. Whisk a bag with about 120 ml cold water, wait 5 minutes for it to set, then top with the biscuit crumbs.
